verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents an official Wizard CLI that detects your framework, installs the right SDK, adds your API key, fires a test event, and produces a first dashboard from one terminal command. That CLI appears scoped to onboarding and instrumentation, not a general-purpose command-line interface. The CI/script management described in docs-13 runs through the Experiment APIs, not a CLI. Missing for 10: a general CLI covering querying data, managing flags, experiments, cohorts or taxonomy; agent-oriented features such as structured/JSON output or non-interactive modes; independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI.
